description: blend/box-corner-three-fillets' body at r 0.5 — three blend cylinders meeting in an octant of a sphere — with a notch cut into the corner: x ≥ 1.7, y ≥ 1.65, z ≤ 1.8, under the sphere's pole at (1.5, 1.5, 2), which the notch leaves alone. The notch's top cuts the corner sphere in a parallel and its two sides in small circles with fitted pcurves, and the sides cut the vertical blend cylinder below it: a fillet's cylinders and its corner sphere cut after they were made (ADR-0020)
